# 0.7.0 — Share Tide objects to MISP

29 September 2026. Minor on **0.6.4**.

Upgrade to publish threats, objectives, and rules to MISP, or regenerate CI so a GitHub production job compares `github.ref` to a literal ref. The share stage stays off until you pass `--sharing`.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.7.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

Regenerate an existing workflow with `opentide setup ci <github|gitlab|azure> --yes`. Add `--sharing` when that pipeline should share changed objects on the default branch.

## Added

- `opentide share` publishes one Tide object as one MISP Event. Commands: `push`, `preview`, `status`, `retract`, `targets`. `preview` and `status` make no request. The API key is never printed ([#184](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/184), [#371](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/371), [#372](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/372)).
- `.opentide/configurations/sharing.toml` merges `[[misp]]` blocks by name ([#370](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/370)).
- Successful shares are recorded in `.opentide/states/sharing.jsonl`. Failures leave the file unchanged ([#373](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/373)).
- `--sharing` / `--no-sharing` on `opentide setup` and `opentide setup ci`. The generated job is `opentide share push --changed`, after generate, on a push to the default branch. Deploy does not wait for it ([#375](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/375)).

## Changed

- Regenerated GitHub workflows compare `github.ref` to `'refs/heads/<branch>'`.
- `share preview` does not require the API key. `push` and `retract` still do.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide share --help
```

Expect `0.7.0`.
